claim: RAG can incorporate the latest documents in a few minutes.
Fine-tuning can take a few hours to days, depending on the model size.
RAG does not modify the underlying LLM.
Fine-tuning adjusts an LLM’s weights and parameters.
Fine-tuning involves additional rounds of training on a smaller, domain-specific data set.
RAG responses provide a reference to the information source.
Fine-tuned model responses do not provide a source reference.
